event_description: Satoshi Nakamoto publishes "Bitcoin: A Peer-to-Peer Electronic Cash System" introducing the protocol and proof-of-work based blockchain.
Genesis block (block 0) mined by Satoshi; Bitcoin network effectively launched.

event_title: First known commercial Bitcoin transaction (Bitcoin Pizza Day)
event_description: Laszlo Hanyecz pays 10,000 BTC for two pizzas. First widely publicized real-world transaction.

event_title: Bitcoin reaches parity with US dollar
event_description: BTC price hits $1 for the first time on some exchanges; early mainstream awareness grows.
Block reward reduced from 50 BTC to 25 BTC — first scheduled supply reduction (halving).
Regulators and policymakers begin paying serious attention; multiple events increase media coverage and adoption.
Law enforcement shuttered Silk Road marketplace and arrested its alleged operator; short-term volatility but overall legitimacy boost.

event_title: BTC surge and first major bull run
event_description: Price rises from low hundreds to >$1,000 — broad public interest and exchange growth.
Mt. Gox, once the largest bitcoin exchange, halts withdrawals and later files for bankruptcy after reporting massive coin losses.

event_title: Microsoft and other early corporate adoption
event_description: Large tech players begin accepting or experimenting with BTC payments (signals corporate interest).
Block reward reduced from 25 BTC to 12.5 BTC; long-term supply dynamic changes.
Network splits and Bitcoin Cash (BCH) is created — highlights governance and scaling debates.

event_title: SegWit activation (first major scaling upgrade activation began earlier in 2017; wider adoption follows)
event_description: Segregated Witness (SegWit) adoption increases capacity and enables second-layer tech (Lightning).
Major retail-driven bull market peaks late 2017 (ICO boom coincides).
Following late 2017 highs, 2018 sees a prolonged bear market across crypto assets.
Announcement sparks regulatory debate and interest; highlights mainstream tech attention on digital currencies.
Global markets and crypto crash as liquidity evaporates; BTC plunges with equities but later recovers strongly.
Block reward reduced from 12.5 BTC to 6.25 BTC; supply issuance halves again.

event_title: MicroStrategy announces BTC purchases (institutional adoption begins)
event_description: MicroStrategy starts buying and holding BTC as treasury reserve asset; followed by other corporates and institutional interest.
Tesla announces large BTC purchase and plans to accept BTC payments (later reverses payments acceptance).

event_title: El Salvador adopts Bitcoin as legal tender
event_description: First country to adopt BTC as legal tender; historic regulatory/adoption milestone.

event_title: First US Bitcoin futures ETF (ProShares) launches earlier months — increased institutional ways to access BTC
event_description: Futures-based ETFs provide regulated exposure to Bitcoin in the US market (note: spot ETF approval later).
Major protocol upgrade improving privacy, smart-contract flexibility, and efficiency.
Terra ecosystem collapse leads to major losses across crypto, triggers liquidity stress in markets.
FTX collapses amid liquidity crisis and alleged mismanagement/fraud; industry-wide shock and regulatory scrutiny intensify.
Multiple jurisdictions increase enforcement and rulemaking; exchanges and token projects face stricter oversight.

event_title: Bitcoin price recovers (post-FTX) and market stabilizes
event_description: After 2022 turmoil, markets gradually stabilize and begin new cycles of institutional investment and product launches.

event_title: SEC approves multiple spot Bitcoin ETFs in US
event_description: Major milestone: US regulators approve the listing and trading of several spot Bitcoin exchange-traded products (ETPs/ETFs), increasing institutional access.

event_title: Increased ETF inflows and regulatory consolidation
event_description: Spot ETF inflows and clearer regulatory frameworks in multiple jurisdictions drive renewed institutional interest.
Block reward halved from 6.25 BTC to 3.125 BTC — supply issuance reduced again.

event_title: Ongoing maturation: custody, derivatives, and macro correlations
event_description: By 2025 the market shows deeper institutional infrastructure (regulated custody, cleared derivatives) and stronger macro correlation analysis use cases.
